tic_tac_toe_rules: There are two teams (opponents) in the game. Team 1 is crosses, Team 2 is noughts. The game is played over three rounds. In each round, the 3x3 playing field is randomly filled with crosses and noughts. Some cells may be left blank. There are 3 types of winning line: horizontal, vertical, or diagonal. A winning line consists of three crosses or three noughts. A horizontal or vertical winning line brings 1 point, a diagonal line brings 2 points. The side that earns the most points over the three rounds wins (a draw is possible).
